24BH1139  Open occupation site on a high bench, area 75 by 100 meters, containing 2 tools and 1 fragment.
24BH1140  Open occupation site on a low bench, area 50 by 50 meters, 1 small point, 1 scraper, and 3 fragments.
24BH141  Temporary occupation site, 15 by 40 meters, on a very high point, containing only minor amounts of lithic material.
24BH142  Small temporary open occupation, 60 by 60 meters, with scarce artifacts, only 2 fragments.
24BH143  Open occupation site, 150 by 150 meters, on a side ridge with 1 complete point and 7 fragments on surface done below surface.
24BH144  Open occupation, 15 by 15 meters, with 1 fragment.
24BH145  Tepee ring on a ridge, 5 by 5 meters; no artifacts.
24BH146  Open occupation site on a ridge, 100 by 100 meters, with widely and scarce distribution of lithic materials. Only 1 fragment found.
24BH147  Temporary open occupation, 20 by 40 meters, on a low bench with 2 scrapers and 4 fragments.
24BH148  Open occupation on a high bench, 10 by 15 meters, with only 1 fragment found.
24BH149  Two groups of tepee rings at two elevations, one area 50 by 20 meters and the other 100 by 20 meters. Total of five rings with little lithic materials on the upper site. The lower site has a profusion of lithic debitage. A local rancher reported having found a grinding stone and an arrow head here. Another complete point was found by this survey crew.
24BH150  A stone ring or tepee ring, 5 by 5 meters, on a pine covered ridge, with no artifacts found.
